About Curve DAO

Curve is a decentralized exchange optimized for low-slippage swaps between similar assets such as stablecoins. Vote-locked CRV directs liquidity rewards and earns fees.

Where this CRV price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (CRV-USD), Binance (CRV/USDT) and Kraken (CRV/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.39B CRV (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
